paragraphs: R. Chama bar Pappa: Sukkah 49b. In R. Yehudah son of R. Simon's name: Kohelet Midrash, on “If the iron is blunt,” and Chazit Midrash, on “Turn your eyes away.” R. Pinchas said in the name of Chama bar Chanina bar Pappa.
